notes.title: Update #2 - 50 Shades of Fall
notes.content:
🐹✨ [b]HEY PARTY PALS, GUESS WHAT’S NEW![/b] ✨🐹

Squeak-squeak, it’s your favorite hamster devs bringing you the biggest update everrrrrrrr (we had to stash a lot of seeds to pull this off)! 🚀 Let’s roll that update wheel:

🎉 [b]NEW GAME: FALL GAME[/b] 🎉
Prepare to tumble, rumble, and maybe even fumble! In this brand-new mode, it’s all about outlasting your friends as the ground literally falls out from under you. Pro tip: Hamsters are great at balance—are you? Fall game is a fun minigame with a goal getting to the end as fast as possible. This game is available in multiplayer aswell!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924698/d59400405f6652e7a3c14167ff4d74ab1216f608.jpg[/img]

🚗 [b]CAR CHAOS JUST GOT CHAOSIER[/b] 🚗
We tuned up the car minigames like a shiny hamster wheel! Expect smoother turns, wilder drifts, and a whole lot more squeaky excitement. Buckle up, because these cars might be small, but they’ve got zoom! Demolition Derby and Racing minigame are now updated with new car behavior and power up rebalance.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924698/4d30dd0c9f79d3769a9aa21933aac992248632b6.jpg[/img]

🎨[b] SHINY NEW GRAPHICS[/b] 🎨
Oooooh, aaaaah! Look at that! The whole game got a hamster-fresh glow-up. It’s shinier than a polished acorn, and we think you’re gonna love all the new sparkles and colors. We have updated graphics in all our games to uplift the experience of all players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924698/f0403840e96a8ed2446e78a3fb494cd5f8a02ff7.png[/img]

Hop on, squeak out to your friends, and let’s party like it’s nut o’clock! Don’t forget to share your funniest fails with us on social media—tag us so we can giggle-snort too! 🐾

[b]Ready, set, party! 🐹❤️[/b]

notes.title: Next update preparations
notes.content:
Greeting our big friends,

It’s been a while since the last update, but we want to share some exciting news with you all! To put aside all rumors - we are working hard on the next update with content for the new games and an upgrade of controls, visuals, and mechanics in most of the current games! Let’s get into it!

[b]Game demo[/b]
We are always striving for more feedback from the community, so with the next update, we will release a demo of MINIGAMES MAYHEM on Steam to reach even more gamers. The demo will most likely include at least three games and showcase the ones we like the most.

[b]New minigame[/b]
We will be releasing a new type of game that will test your running skills again but differently! You will be able to compete with friends in an online mode of racing 3D tracks that will test your skills and endurance. Who will have the best time?

[b]Visual upgrade[/b]
We have noticed that shadows are absent from the current version of our game. We will fix that with further visual upgrades, which will be thoroughly tested to ensure that they do not influence players' performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924698/f0403840e96a8ed2446e78a3fb494cd5f8a02ff7.png[/img]

[b]Game mechanics upgrade[/b]
Jump up, racing games, and many others will be updated with better controls and mechanics. All of those are direct reactions to your feedback so THANK YOU! Games will receive game settings when you are able to configure your gaming experience to your liking and in Demolition Derby, even have the option to bind power-ups to specific keys.

We hope these changes will again push Minigames Mayhem to more players and give us a better understanding of what our lovely players want to play!

Squeeeek you later!

notes.title: Update Smash & Spin
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924698/37a4e39b32c4a5879fbd3c1931bbddb93dc044c3.png[/img]

Hey, all you furry friends! It’s your favorite little fluffball here with a super exciting update about our latest collection, [b]MINIGAMES MAYHEM![/b] We’ve been busy scurrying around in our wheels, and guess what? [b]The first major update is here![/b]

Update [b]Smash & Spin[/b] is packed with delicious goodies! 

[list]
[*] New games alert! [b]Demolition Showdown[/b] – Time to zoom and vroom!
[*] Cabaret Roulette joins the fun – it’s a spin-tastic time!
[*] We’ve spruced up the [b]Mile-High Jump[/b] with even more bouncy features!
[*] We also added a shiny sci-fi map for all your space hamsters! 
[*] You can now sit back in Spectator mode and watch the fun unfold!
[*] Plus, more maps are needed for our [b]Mayhem Race[/b]! 
[*] The [b]Zombie Friday[/b] is hopping in with 2 new maps to explore!
[*] And don’t forget the new skins, leaderboards, and achievements in all minigames, just waiting to be claimed!
[/list]

[b]MINIGAMES MAYHEM[/b] is about that party vibe, letting you compete with your pals online! Imagine up to 50 of your best buddies bouncing around in the [b]Mile-High Jump[/b], our jumping minigame! And soon, we’re aiming to double the fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924698/ec4bb58abcf68dd6eee09bea4281582d684a8be9.png[/img]

[b]Racers[/b], get ready! Our racing tracks in [b]Demolition Showdown[/b] are full of wild power-ups that’ll keep you on your toes! And for those local multiplayer moments, [b]Zombie Friday[/b], our running minigame, has a hardcore mode for courage-race enthusiasts!

Oh, and did I mention [b]Cabaret Roulette[/b]? It’s a clever twist where you play with cards instead of just items. It’s all about strategy and surprises, like me hiding snacks in my little house!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924698/8d2f9ebe63dce712de30498c89bcb4fd8b0b8d67.png[/img]

Our games are available in nine languages and cost just $4.99, so everyone can enjoy the fun without chewing through their food stash!

We're all ears (and paws!) to your feedback. We love creating new games and tweaking the old ones with the help of our incredible community on Discord and social media!

So hop over to [b]HasterHam Games[/b] and let the party gaming bonanza begin!

Remember to check out our Steam page for MINIGAMES MAYHEM and join the furry fun on social media with hashtags like #MINIGAMESMAYHEM and #HamsterHam!

Enjoy the games, little friends!
Squeak you later!

notes.title: Development update #10 - Work continues!
notes.content:
Hello there!

As we are closing in on the testing phase of the first update, we want to share with you some information about it. Our programmers are currently focused on one of the new games coming in the update, a little secret project, and a feature for jumping minigames that will put your friends under constant stress.

The feature we are teasing is of course spectator mode! This mode will be available in the online mode when you are jumping with your friends. When playing, you will be able to press a button and change your camera to spectate other players in the lobby. This is something we were given as feedback as our friends and players wanted to view other jumping and maybe look up some strategies for hard jumps.

As a part of the update, we are also looking into the balance and setup of the racing minigame. We are currently testing some changes that will increase the time spent in the race and overall try to give players better control over the car's behavior. This was something that was hinted to us by one of our friends who thrives in racing games and he was right!

We hope this short developer update finds you well and we are eager to share more information next time!

Best regards,
Team Minigames Mayhem

notes.title: Development update #9 - First big update comming
notes.content:
Greetings,

We hope everybody is enjoying the Minigames and are having fun! We already have the first hotfix behind us and we are looking forward to the first big update! We want to make sure you get your money's worth and we intend to expand every single minigame and add a new one! What you can expat? Well, let’s see!

[b]New Game - Cabaret Roulette[/b]
We are currently in the process of developing two new games - You will see one in the next update and the other one a little bit later on. For now, we can share the one that will be present in the first big update - “Cabaret Roulette”. A popular game inspires the game we played a lot and we want to iterate on that idea with a multiplayer option. You will be playing as a character in a game where only one can win. We want to create some unique twist so players will be also playing with cards and strategizing against opponents - maybe you can bluff your way into winning the roulette?

To address the “coming soon” games shown in the menu - these are technically more challenging games and we need a little bit more time for them to work properly.

[b]Jumping minigame[/b]
We will be adding a new sci-fi map that is an extension of all the mechanics we have already implemented and more! This map will include again quests and will challenge even experienced players!

[b]Racing minigame[/b]
The racing minigame will receive a well-deserved new maps. the amount of added maps will be between 2-4 depending on our testing in case some of the maps do not go through our internal playtesting. We currently work on military map, galaxy map, underwater map, and lava map.

[b]Runner minigame[/b]
Runner minigame will receive new maps as well! We will introduce a mall and rural-urban maps. These maps have some unique twists so players can challenge themselves

[b]Additional planned content[/b]
We intend to add additional leaderboards, achievements, and skins during this update. These will be linked to the new maps we will introduce so players have new content to try out.

We are glad that the first players were pleased with the Minigames Mayhem and we hope future updates will increase the amount of content players can play and enjoy. if you wish to give us some feedback, feel free to visit our discord and leave feedback there!

P.S.: Here are some development screens from the new game!

notes.title: Development update #7 - Showcase of game UI and future updates
notes.content:
Greetings,

We want to give you an update on how things are going. We are currently trying to fix one of the last bugs that are evading us (one specific crash when quitting the game) which is pretty annoying. It is nothing that would break the game, but we want to present you with a clean and smooth game experience even during the launch.

We have been teasing the release in previous posts quite a bit and to be completely transparent, some hiccups happened. We could push through them and probably release the game with them, but it is not an approach we want to take. As a "compensation" for a bit delayed release. We will showcase the main menu UI that is currently in our game. Bear in mind we will be taking feedback and if some upgrades will be suggested, we will gladly incorporate them in further updates.

If everything goes right, the next news will contain the release date and roadmap for you to look at so be sure to wishlist and follow the game on Steam or follow us on social media so you don't miss this information!

Team HasterHam games

notes.title: Development update #6 - Build 0.XX and Maps
notes.content:
[b]Greetings everyone!
[/b]
As we stated in a previous announcement we are currently working on the build that will be released on Steam. We have already submitted the build for the Steam review and we have been given all the necessary feedback that is needed to release the game. That is mostly a job for our programmers as they work hard to iterate all necessary aspects to comply with this feedback. 

Meanwhile, we are working on some additions to our games which not require a programmer's touch. To be more specific, new maps for a jumping minigame which will be situated in a sci-fi tower, and 2-3 new racing tracks for the racing minigame. All of these will be released as a part of an update (Don't worry a free update) after launch. If you are asking why not release these maps during the launch, it is very simple - we want to test those maps properly and not release them with some critical bugs.

Current maps in our game build have been already tested by us and even thou we tried to be thorough, we are open to feedback and ready to fix any possible issues with the current maps in the first build.

As for the release date, we are waiting for our next build to be approved and when it does, we will set a release date and publish a second trailer for all of you to watch.

P.S. We are adding a picture of a cat that is a beloved pet of our programmer!

Have a great day!
Team of Minigames mayhem

notes.title: Development update #4 - Language support
notes.content:
Hello!

We have a short update that includes localization for our Steam page. We are currently supporting Czech, English, Polish, French, Portuguese, German and Spanish language. Please note that we are using AI to translate text with our internal language knowledge so there might be some translation errors. If you find any, be sure to give us feedback and we will work on fixing any errors.

We are currently also working on a trailer which will be created after we finish work on our GUI. We are currently implementing the last UI elements and screens which include Multiplayer lobbies, leaderboard UI, and the racing minigame UI. All of these will be ready very soon and we are very happy with how they turned out!

After the trailer is done, the timeline will move very quickly and we want to publish a Steam build which will be version 1.0. We already have several content updates ready which we will be slowly pushing out as we release the game. The reason some of this content won't be in the release build is, that we want to test and polish all the content before we release it to you guys. Of course, you might find some bugs and errors but we will work on removing them as we want 100% your feedback on such a matter.

notes.title: Development update #3
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

We are getting closer and closer to the release and to the trailer, which will show the most from the gameplay! As we are getting ready, we are monitoring more closely the ways, how we can make our game more accessible to gamers.

In the first place, we are planning to have our game translated into several languages. Currently, you are seeing only English and Czech in-game specifications but our internal build is currently already supporting also Spanish, Italian, German, and Polish! We want to add also Portuguese and French to cover the most popular languages on Steam. Be aware that our ability to translate text is not that good and we will be glad for all feedback once the game is released! In the future, we want to add more languages and work with the community here on Steam AND on our official Discord server to upgrade and polish the translations.

The other thing about accessibility is of course controls. We will be supporting Keyboards + Mouse, Xbox controllers, and PlayStation controllers. While on the day of release, you won't find a way to key bind buttons to your desire, it is a feature that will definitely come in future updates! If you will be playing on controllers, you are able to remap the buttons in Steam itself so if you need to do that for any reason, go for it! Again, this is something we want to get right and we would appreciate any feedback on this matter

Lastly, we also recognize that gamers can suffer from some kind of eye disorder. We have been paying attention to this during development and most of the icons and indicators are designed in a way so that for instance any colorblind gamers will be always able to recognize everything.

[b]Do you have any recommendations for us about these matters? Leave a comment to give us some tips![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924698/d9d3f245b928738fcc5e265aee0334d938247919.png[/img]

notes.title: Development update #2
notes.content:
[b]Greetings fellow gamers![/b]

As we are getting closer to release, we would like to take a closer look at some features our game will include. Keep in mind, that this is an early access version, and not only are all of these features subject to change, but also that we will keep expanding the number of features that players will engage with.

Achievements are a core of most of the modern games. Our game will be no different and we will offer a variety of achievements that are specific for each featured game. A lot of these achievements have skins linked to them so If you are a passionate achievement hunter, you will be not only rewarded with a sense of accomplishment but also with unique skins to show off during sessions with friends.

While getting achievements is great and showing them off on your Steam profile can be great, we will be also introducing leaderboards, which will show your progression and standing among other players and friends. These leaderboards will be expanding and we will try to keep them competitive for as long as the game is developed.

Other features like cloud save, Steam screenshot, or Steam overlay are planned too but as these are pretty standard, we don't have special updates for them. All of these features can be found on the Steam page of our game where you will be able to track which of them are already included in the game.

In the future, we are planning to add a Steam workshop. This will enable all players to create custom maps and share them with other players. As this feature is quite big and complicated, we will be introducing it later in the development cycle. We will be gathering player feedback on what they want from the workshop as well.

What other features you would like to see? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924698/108f6b287efdae0b70e04a8ddc57acdff34786ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Development update #1
notes.content:
[b]Hello, everyone![/b]

Welcome to our first development update! We are glad you ended up reading this post and we hope you will like our little project which focuses on minigames. We are currently in a phase of creating playable builds and we are actively testing all minigames, which will be available at launch. 

Currently, we are working on a jumping "minigame" which was inspired by a lot of successful rage games where players aim to reach the top of the map. Not only in this game you will be able to jump to the end, but you will be provided with leaderboards that will show your standing compared to the rest of the players and your friends. Also, we wanted players to have something more in this type of game, so we are working on quests, which will be completed during the time gameplay. You might find some funny references there!

The second game which we are working on is a car racing game. In this game, your focus will be on surviving each round against your opponents. You will be using power-ups and trickery to achieve this so be prepared for some crazy racing situations. Of course, we wanted to add something of our won, and each round will be affected by some special condition, which will alter your gameplay so be ready and watch out for these events!

Lastly, we are preparing a running game, where the goal of the player will be to survive for as long as possible. This will be harder and harder the further you get and we have prepared a special stamina system, that will force you, players, to run as efficiently as possible.

These are the first minigames we are preparing but don't worry, we are already working on two more NEW minigames which we will explore further in the future, and of course upgrades for the minigames mentioned above. We are planning to add new maps, game modes, and features to create a small miniverse where every player can find a game to dominate!

Are you ready for mayhem?!
